text: 午后宽基ETF成交额持续放大，创业板ETF易方达（159915）、科创50ETF华夏（588000）、沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞（510300）成交额突破100亿，中证1000ETF南方（512100）、中证500ETF南方（510500）、A500ETF华泰柏瑞（563360）、A500ETF南方（159352）、创业板50ETF华安（159949）成交额均已超昨日全天。
text_en: Broad-based ETF trading volume continued to expand in the afternoon. The turnover of ChiNext ETF E Fund (159915), STAR 50 ETF ChinaAMC (588000), and CSI 300 ETF Huatai-PineBridge (510300) exceeded RMB 100 billion each. The turnover of CSI 1000 ETF Southern (512100), CSI 500 ETF Southern (510500), A500 ETF Huatai-PineBridge (563360), A500 ETF Southern (159352), and ChiNext 50 ETF Hua An (159949) had all surpassed their total yesterday's volume.
